An interactive course · from zero to large language models

AI from First Principles

A learning path from fitting a straight line to how Transformers, Mamba and large language models work. Every concept comes with the core idea, its key formula, an animated explainer and a worked example, and many have a live lab you can play with. Undergraduate maths is all you need.

    Every concept in the course, one column per chapter. A line joins each concept to the earlier ones it builds on. Hover or focus a concept to trace everything it needs and everything it unlocks; select it to open the lesson.

    How to use this course. Follow the numbered path, or jump to any concept and use its prerequisites to fill gaps. On each page, read the idea and the formula, play the explainer, work through the example, then try the lab. Mark a concept learned when you could explain it to a friend.

    Notes. Progress is saved in this browser only. Labs run entirely on your device; some are simplified toy versions, and say so. Equations are typeset with MathJax. Vectors are bold, matrices are capitals, and θ always means the model’s parameters.
